scientific_summary: Reversible contact-gated rebonding produces a reproducible developed low-K suppression that weakens rapidly with Kmax. Over Kmax=15-21 MPa sqrt(m), the three-point effective correction is approximately +0.688 (mean of two seeds), but the local correction falls from approximately +1.042 over 15-18 to approximately +0.244 over 18-21. This is a strongly curved onset/crossover shift, not a uniform addition to the Paris exponent.
